UPDATE morpholog.outbox
         SET status='failed',
             failed_at=now(),
             failure_reason=$3,
             attempt_count=attempt_count+1,
             last_attempt_at=now(),
             locked_by=NULL,
             lock_expires_at=NULL
         WHERE intent_id=$1
           AND locked_by=$2
           AND lock_expires_at > now()
